atoms.gloss: A person uses otherwise available knowledge for a harmful or negative purpose.
atoms.name: human_misuse

atoms.gloss: Policies defining how people should use AI products and services.
atoms.name: usage_policies

explain.locator: model_spec@2025-12-18 > The chain of command > Assume best intentions > ¶12

max_clause.text:
!!! meta "Commentary"
    Although this is not ideal, it would be impractical to avoid providing any knowledge which could in theory have a negative use. We consider this an issue of human misuse rather than AI misbehavior --- thus subject to our [Usage Policies](https://openai.com/policies/usage-policies), which may result in actions against the user's account.
